_doc: Diamond, coloured-gem, jade, lapis and turquoise sources; endowment in carats of rough, given only where a defensible figure exists. endowment is the total known resource, production to date plus remaining reserves (not only reserves, not oil or ore in place), to order of magnitude; where no defensible figure exists the key is omitted rather than guessed. conf: A = figure checked against a cited source in the audit, B = coordinate checked on Wikipedia and endowment approximate, C = from memory or a secondary summary. Entries with a status of modern are producing or recently producing; historic are worked out or pre-1800.

entries.name: Kimberley (Big Hole)
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. Wikipedia: the Kimberley mine yielded three tons of diamonds, about fifteen million carats.
entries.contained_basis: Big Hole yielded 3,000 kg of diamonds (14.5 million carats) by 1914; carat 0.2 g; production only
entries.contained_source: Wikipedia, Kimberley Mine, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kimberley_Mine : "yielding 3,000 kilograms (14,504,566 carats) of diamonds" (1914)

entries.name: Argyle
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. Wikipedia: more than 865 million carats of rough produced 1983-2020; mine closed, remaining resource small.
entries.contained_basis: More than 865 million carats of rough produced 1983 to 2020 x 0.2 g per carat = 173 t; mine closed 2020
entries.contained_source: Wikipedia, Argyle diamond mine, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argyle_diamond_mine : "producing more than 865 million carats of rough diamonds" (closed November 2020)

entries.name: Mir
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. Wikipedia: about ten million carats a year in the 1960s falling to about two million; total of order a hundred million carats is an estimate from that, C.
entries.contained_basis: Mir has produced over 200 million carats x 0.2 g per carat = 40 t; production only, a lower bound (another site gives about 360 million carats but was not opened to a source)
entries.contained_source: ShowCaves, Mir diamond mine, https://showcaves.com/english/ru/mines/Mir.html : "Mir has produced over 200 million carats of diamonds"

entries.name: Jwaneng
entries.source: Coordinate from memory; annual output times mine life, order of magnitude.
entries.contained_basis: Derived: reserves 88.3 Mct at December 2012 plus production 1982 to 2012 of 30 years x 12 Mct per year (the lower end of the stated 12 to 15 Mct per year average, assumed constant) = 448 Mct x 0.2 g per carat = 89.7 t
entries.contained_source: Mining Technology, Jwaneng Diamond Mine, https://www.mining-technology.com/projects/jwaneng-diamond-mine/ : "estimated reserves of 88.3 million carats or 70.1 million tonnes ... as of December 2012"; "The mine has an average production rate of 12 to 15 million carats per year"

entries.name: Murowa
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. Production plus resource, order of magnitude from memory. The earlier entry was nearly two degrees west.
entries.contained_basis: Reserves 19 Mt ore x 0.9 carats per tonne = 17.1 million carats x 0.2 g = 3.4 t; production not added (page undated)
entries.contained_source: Wikipedia, Murowa diamond mine, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Murowa_diamond_mine : "mine reserves are 19 million tonnes of ore, with an ore grade of 0.9 carats (180 mg) per tonne"

entries.name: Finsch
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. Production plus resource, order of magnitude from memory. The earlier entry was 1.4 degrees north and 2 degrees east of the mine.
entries.contained_basis: Finsch has supplied over 126 million carats in its 40-plus-year life (undated, about 2011 to 2015) x 0.2 g per carat = 25.2 t; production only, a lower bound
entries.contained_source: Wikipedia, Petra Diamonds, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petra_Diamonds : "Finsch is a major producer, having supplied over 126 million carats in its 40 plus year life to date"

entries.name: Muzo
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No defensible endowment figure, omitted.
entries.contained_basis: Only one recovery was found: the operator MTC recovered 152,000 carats from one area in May 2015 x 0.2 g per carat = 30 kg, a very small lower bound; five centuries of output are not quantified (World Mining Report 2005 puts Colombian output at 5 to 6 million carats a year in the 1990s with Muzo about 10% of it, which would be on the order of a tonne, not used because the shares are for 2005)
entries.contained_source: Earth Wonders, Beryl from Muzo mine, https://earthwonders.com/wiki/beryl_from_muzo-mine_colombia_174952 : "a dramatic MTC recovery in May 2015, when one area yielded 152,000 carats"; World Mining Report 2005, Central and South America, https://www.ganoksin.com/borisat/nenam/wmr-05-csamerica.htm

entries.name: Chivor
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No defensible endowment figure, omitted. The earlier entry was 0.4 degrees north of Chivor.
entries.contained_basis: Recorded yields only: 137,000 carats 1925 to 1929, 5,400 in 1947, 82,370 in 1948, 91,656 in 1949 and 7,177 in 1950 = 323,603 carats x 0.2 g per carat = 64.7 kg; other years are not given, so a small lower bound
entries.contained_source: Schmetzer, Martayan and Blake, History of the Chivor Emerald Mine, Part II (1924-1970), Gems & Gemology, Summer 2020, https://www.gia.edu/gems-gemology/summer-2020-history-of-the-chivor-emerald-mine-part-2 : "In the period from 1925 to 1929, the mine yielded 137,000 carats in total"; "5,400 carats in 1947 ... 82,370 carats in 1948 and 91,656 carats in 1949"; "Reported yield for 1950 amounted only to 7,177 carats"

entries.name: Mogok
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No defensible endowment figure, omitted.

entries.name: Mong Hsu
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No defensible endowment figure, omitted. The earlier entry was one degree west.

entries.name: Ratnapura
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No defensible endowment figure, omitted.

entries.name: Panna
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No defensible endowment figure, omitted.
entries.contained_basis: Madhya Pradesh reserves plus resources 28,597,036 carats as on 1 April 2020 x 0.2 g per carat = 5.72 t; assumes the state's diamond estimate stands for the Panna belt (Majhgawan is the producing mine); production not added
entries.contained_source: Indian Bureau of Mines, Indian Minerals Yearbook 2021, Diamond, https://ibm.gov.in/writereaddata/files/01312023164827Diamond_2021.pdf : Table 1, Madhya Pradesh total 28,597,036 carats (reserves and resources, 1.4.2020)

entries.name: Kollur (Golconda diamonds)
entries.source: Historic Golconda-trade alluvial diamond mines on the Krishna river; coordinate from memory (Golconda fort itself is 17.38N 78.40E per Wikipedia). No endowment figure.

entries.name: Sar-i Sang
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. Lapis lazuli worked since the Neolithic; no endowment figure.

entries.name: Sleeping Beauty (Globe, Arizona)
entries.source: Coordinate is Globe, Arizona per Wikipedia; mine nearby. No endowment figure. Renamed from sleep_canyon_turquoise.

entries.name: Kingman
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No endowment figure.

entries.name: Nishapur
entries.source: Coordinate is Nishapur city per Wikipedia; the mines lie tens of kilometres away. No endowment figure.

entries.name: Hotan (Khotan) nephrite
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. Alluvial nephrite of the Yurungkash and Karakash rivers. No endowment figure. Replaces nephrite_jade, which sat in Qinghai.

entries.name: Hpakant
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No endowment figure.

entries.name: Merelani Hills
entries.source: Coordinate from memory (Mererani, Manyara Region). Replaces tanzanite_deposit, which was mislabelled sapphire and placed near Arusha. No endowment figure.
entries.contained_basis: Reserves 109 million carats (2018 national report) + about 2 million carats mined 1967 to 1971 = 111 Mct x 0.2 g per carat = 22.2 t; production after 1971 (2.4 Mct in 2011 alone) is not added
entries.contained_source: Wikipedia, Tanzanite, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanzanite : "an estimated two million carats of tanzanite were mined" from 1967 until 1971; "Total reserves of tanzanite are estimated at 109,000,000 carats, according to a report published in 2018"

entries.name: Yogo Gulch
entries.source: Coordinate from memory (Judith Basin County, Montana). Replaces sapphire_montana, whose coordinate was 2.4 degrees west. No endowment figure.
entries.contained_basis: English Mine recovered over 16 million carats of rough sapphire 1899 to 1929 plus at least 28 million carats still in the ground = 44 Mct x 0.2 g per carat = 8.8 t
entries.contained_source: Wikipedia, Yogo sapphire, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yogo_sapphire : "recovered more than 16 million carats (3.2 t) of rough sapphires"; "at least 28 million carats (5.6 t ...) of Yogo sapphires are still in the ground"

entries.name: San Carlos
entries.source: Coordinate from memory (San Carlos Apache Reservation, Arizona). No endowment figure.

entries.name: Coober Pedy
entries.source: Coordinate from Wikipedia. No endowment figure. The earlier entry was three degrees north.
